task: landmark identity + visibility + green-light anchor + image bearing; bbox auxiliary; mask not required

candidates.task_fit: detection bbox + one keypoint in a single network; directly emits green-light anchor and optional bbox
candidates.model_version: Ultralytics v8.2.0 asset (yolov8n-pose.pt from the v8.2.0 release referenced by RKNN model zoo)
candidates.input: RGB letterboxed 640x640; custom dataset one class tower, one keypoint green roof light
candidates.outputs: class score/bbox + one keypoint (x,y,visibility) -> anchor + image bearing
candidates.params_approx: nano scale; exact parameter/FLOP count must be recorded from the frozen export

license.code_and_weights: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics); custom weights are derivatives; commercial/closed distribution requires legal review or a commercial license

deployment_evidence.onnx_export: Ultralytics export docs list ONNX; exact opset/version must be frozen at export
deployment_evidence.rknn_model_zoo: official airockchip model zoo includes yolov8_pose; README lists RK3576 support and INT8 benchmark 75.0 FPS single-core for yolov8n-pose
deployment_evidence.rknn_version: RKNN Model Zoo 2.5.0 / RKNPU SDK >=2.5.0 (model zoo README)

risks: COCO human-pose pretraining does not match a tower keypoint; custom labels required
green light is 4-10 px in current 320x240 images; 640 letterbox may still be marginal
custom pose export/quantization on RK3576 is not verified
candidates.annotation_cost: bbox + one keypoint per target; negatives as empty labels; visibility flags

candidates.task_fit: detection bbox only; green-light anchor remains a classical color/geometry stage, so anchor is not learned end-to-end
candidates.model_version: YOLOX 0.1.1rc0 weights (yolox_nano.pth); code/tag to be frozen in isolated environment
candidates.input: RGB 416x416 default; custom one-class tower detection
candidates.outputs: tower bbox; green anchor via existing color/geometry validation

license.code_and_weights: Apache-2.0 (YOLOX repository); COCO pretrained weights/dataset terms require separate review

deployment_evidence.onnx_export: YOLOX repository provides ONNXRuntime deployment demo
deployment_evidence.rknn_model_zoo: official model zoo lists YOLOX (yolox_s/m) for RK3576; YOLOX-Nano is not explicitly listed, so nano RKNN conversion is UNKNOWN

risks: anchor stage remains heuristic and failed in the previous test
YOLOX-Nano not in official RKNN zoo list
lower task fit than keypoint model
candidates.annotation_cost: bbox only; anchor labels optional for evaluation but not needed for training

candidates.task_fit: mask is not consumed by V2.2 landmark relay; mask output does not add a required decision
candidates.deployment_evidence: RKNN model zoo lists yolov8_seg for RK3576; deployment is possible but not the deciding issue
candidates.rejection_reason: no current downstream consumer requires a mask; annotation cost and output complexity exceed the task contract; do not adopt without a mask-facing consumer

decision.decision_condition: main is conditional on resolving AGPL obligations; if AGPL is unacceptable, backup is evaluated first but its anchor remains a known weak stage
decision.rk3576_status: UNKNOWN for our custom weights and quantized model; official zoo examples are not a custom-model validation
